"""Main checks the opt-in production event collector against its clean source base."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections, difflib, fcntl, hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, shlex, time, traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W=G/'.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012'
BASE=G/'.worktree/diag-native-grouped-event-20261012'
X=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
T=X/'.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install';L=X/'.lint'
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def module(name,p):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p);v=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(v);return v
m=module('leaf_service_lint_owner',O)
leg=module('leaf_service_line_findings',B/'latest-update-mandatory-lints-cpp-v4.py')
leg.W=W;leg.P=BASE;leg.U=BASE
ENV=dict(PATH=str(T/'bin')+':'+str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':'+str(L/'cppcheck/usr/bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(L/'cppcheck/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(T/'lib')+':/opt/intel/oneapi/compiler/2026.1/lib:/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib')
def ident(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-root-v2';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=ident(Path(__file__)))
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands;started=time.monotonic()
 def run(label,args,cwd=W,env=ENV,wall=600,allowed=(0,)):
  left=1800-(time.monotonic()-started);assert left>0
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,cwd,wall=min(wall,left),cpu=wall*5,rss_cap=16<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=128<<20,file_cap=128<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return c,so.read_text(),se.read_text()
 try:
  bp=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-build-root-v2/record.json';build=json.loads(bp.read_text())
  assert build['passed'] and build['complete'] and not build['active']
  pins=build['source_pins'];assert all(m.sha(W/p)==v for p,v in pins.items())
  r['build_receipt']=ident(bp);r['source_pins']=pins
  assert not run('base-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],BASE)[1].strip()
  assert run('base-head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'],BASE)[1].strip()=='338fe69004038fa0f29576e62345f936661d0e6d'
  files=sorted(pins);existing={p:BASE/p for p in files if (BASE/p).is_file()};maps={}
  for name,p in existing.items():
   maps[name]={}
   for a,z,n in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,p.read_text().splitlines(),(W/name).read_text().splitlines(),autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks():
    for i in range(n):maps[name][z+i+1]=a+i+1
  r['baseline_source_pins']={p:m.sha(v) for p,v in existing.items()}
  db=out/'baseline-db';db.mkdir();rows=[]
  for original in json.loads((W/'build/free/compile_commands.json').read_text()):
   p=Path(original['file'])
   if not p.is_relative_to(W) or str(p.relative_to(W)) not in existing:continue
   row=dict(original);name=str(p.relative_to(W))
   def adapt(value):
    for area in ['src','include','tools','tests','third_party']:
     value=re.sub(re.escape(str(W/area))+r'(?=/|$)',str(BASE/area),value)
    return value
   row['file']=str(existing[name]);row['arguments']=[adapt(v) for v in row.get('arguments',shlex.split(row.get('command','')))];row.pop('command',None);rows.append(row)
  assert rows;(db/'compile_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  previous_p=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-lints-root-v1/record.json'
  previous=json.loads(previous_p.read_text())
  assert previous['active'] is False and previous['baseline_source_pins']==r['baseline_source_pins']
  bc=next(v for v in previous['commands'] if v['label']=='baseline-lints')
  assert m.closed(bc) and bc['session_anchored'] and bc['exit_code'] in (0,1)
  bso=previous['evidence']['baseline-lints']['stdout'];bse=previous['evidence']['baseline-lints']['stderr']
  r['baseline_reused_receipt']=ident(previous_p)
  r['baseline_reuse_scope']='Actual earlier owned baseline lint; source bytes/flags unchanged. Candidate lints execute again.'
  # An orphan new header has no inferred compile command; use the actual core TU's SYCL flags.
  candidate_db=out/'candidate-db';candidate_db.mkdir()
  candidate_rows=json.loads((W/'build/free/compile_commands.json').read_text())
  source_row=next(v for v in candidate_rows if v['file']==str(W/'src/core/device.cpp'))
  header='include/strata/core/service_events.hpp'
  row=dict(source_row);row['file']=str(W/header)
  row['arguments']=[v.replace(str(W/'src/core/device.cpp'),str(W/header)) for v in shlex.split(row.pop('command'))]
  candidate_rows.append(row);(candidate_db/'compile_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidate_rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  cc,cso,cse=run('candidate-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],env=dict(ENV,STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(candidate_db)),allowed=(0,1))
  for tool in ['clang-tidy','cppcheck','codespell','reuse']:
   assert '== '+tool in bso and '== '+tool in cso,tool
  assert 'skipped (' not in bso+cso and 'possible secret' not in bso+cso
  assert not cso.split('== reuse\n')[-1].strip()
  before=leg.findings(bso+'\n'+bse);after=leg.findings(cso+'\n'+cse,maps)
  added=sorted(set(after)-set(before))
  r['lint_comparison']=dict(baseline_exit=bc['exit_code'],candidate_exit=cc['exit_code'],baseline=before,candidate=after,added=added,normalization='Primary path/line/message on exactly unchanged source; repeated reports of the same location count once. New files have no inherited findings.')
  save();assert not added,added
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],wall=180)
  for mode in ['free','contrib-llvm']:
   for name in [p for p in pins if p.endswith('.cpp')]:
    rows=[v for v in json.loads((W/'build'/mode/'compile_commands.json').read_text()) if v['file']==str(W/name)]
    assert rows and all('-Wall' in v.get('command','') and '-Wextra' in v.get('command','') and '-Werror' in v.get('command','') for v in rows)
  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==v for p,v in pins.items());r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','lint_comparison']}))
 raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
